verdict.rationale: The only webhook evidence is one line in the call-summaries doc saying a dedicated webhook fires on call-summary events. That shows Quo's own API has outbound event callbacks, but only one event type is evidenced, and nothing describes how to register or manage subscriptions or what the payloads contain. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/management API, catalog of subscribable events (messages, calls, contacts), payload schema and signature verification, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A dedicated webhook triggers on call-summary events.
